meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动保存任务计划和进度,中断后接着干
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常让 AI 助手处理多步骤任务却担心丢进度
copy.tagline_en: Keep task plans and progress in files, recover automatically after interruptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI agents for complex multi-step work and worry about losing progress.

howto.what: Claude 会把计划、发现、进度分别写进 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md;决策前先读计划,每完成一个阶段就更新状态、记录错误。上下文清空后会重读这些文件恢复工作,并只把它们当数据,不当指令执行。
howto.when: 当用户要求规划、拆分或组织多步项目、研究任务,或任何预计需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时;上下文因 /clear 清空后也会自动读取计划文件恢复。

say.text: 帮我把这个调研拆成步骤,写成计划文件。
say.note: Claude 会创建三个计划文件并持续更新。

say.text: 我搜索完几轮了,把新发现记进 findings.md。
say.note: 遵循每两次搜索后立即保存要点的规则。

say.text: 准备好继续执行计划里的下一步了。
say.note: Claude 会先重读 task_plan.md 再继续。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk, re-reads the plan before decisions, updates status/errors after each phase, and re-reads files after context loss. It treats content as data, not commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. After /clear it re-reads planning files to recover.

say_en.text: Break this research into steps and write a plan file.
say_en.note: Claude creates the plan files and keeps updating them.

say_en.text: I finished a few search rounds; save the new findings now.
Ready to move on to the next step of the plan.
